name: Five-colour sticky rice
summary: Coloured sticky rice for the Long Tong trays at Bo Lu, and for the house at Pac Ngoi. VietnamPlus puts it on the 2026 offering trays with glutinous wine. VnExpress names it among the homestay foods. The plants that dye it are check on arrival. This photograph is the dish as taken in Sơn La.
origin: Ba Be. The photograph is the same dish in Sơn La.
culture: VietnamPlus puts xôi ngũ sắc on the 2026 Long Tong offering trays at Bo Lu, with glutinous wine. VnExpress names it among the foods at the Pac Ngoi houses. VOV’s 2019 night-market note lists it with bamboo-tube rice and grilled lake fish. No 2025 or 2026 notice says that market still opens.
howToEat: Take it from the offering table at Long Tong, or at the house when they are serving it. It is not a stall with a printed price.
The five plants that dye it were not on the pages read. That is check on arrival. Upland sticky rice, xôi nếp nương, is a different bowl on the same table.
where: Bo Lu, on the festival ground at Long Tong. Pac Ngoi, at the house. The 2019 weekend market at Pac Ngoi listed it, and whether that market still opens is check on arrival.
